n-b-1.reason: 'l. ij. D. de li. ho. exhib.' — the title De libero homine exhibendo (D. 43.29), which the book cites as 'D. de lib. ho. exhib.' at annot-084 n. g and annot-086 n. f and 'D. de liber. exhib.' at annot-020 n. h; a bare 'de lib. exhib.' would be the neighbouring title De liberis exhibendis. Moderate confidence: decided from the parallel citations, not from the glyphs.; The title is *De libero homine exhibendo* (D. 43.29), the interdict for producing a detained free man, which is the point of Coras's second sense of *arrest*; annot-086's margin prints the same title as *D. de lib. ho. exhib.*, so the *ho* of reading B is expected and reading A drops it.
